verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a fair question for a work-management platform, but the evidence pack never documents a bulk-edit or multi-item operation capability. The GraphQL API and SDKs are developer building blocks a user could use to construct bulk updates. Agent marketing such as 'Score our open deals and send proposals' is an illustrative prompt, not documented bulk-operation support.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
